description:
Create a structural engineering elevation drawing of a reinforced concrete beam in LibreCAD. 

Goal: Draw a beam 5000mm long x 600mm deep with top/bottom longitudinal reinforcement and vertical stirrups spaced at 200mm centers.

Specifications:
1. Units: Millimeters (mm).
2. Beam Geometry: Draw a 5000x600 rectangle on layer 'CONCRETE' (Color: Gray/8). Lower-left corner at (0,0).
3. Main Reinforcement: Draw two horizontal lines on layer 'REBAR_MAIN' (Color: Red/1) representing top and bottom bars. Use 40mm clear cover (lines at Y=40 and Y=560).
4. Stirrups: Draw vertical lines on layer 'REBAR_STIRRUPS' (Color: Green/3). Start at X=100 and repeat every 200mm along the beam length (approx 25 stirrups).
5. Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/rc_beam_elevation.dxf'.
